selection: Hot tokens per network by estimated on-network value (lower of CoinGecko market cap and on-chain supply x price) in a 2026-09-21 snapshot, after activity filters (24h volume, holder counts) and exclusions (tokenized stocks/funds, vault/receipt tokens, superseded, deprecated or sanctioned tokens). Each address is cross-checked against CoinGecko plus at least one independent list, and decimals are verified on-chain. A listing only lets the app display a name, symbol, decimals and icon offline; it is not an endorsement, safety rating or live ranking.

sources.name: CoinGecko API
sources.use: market-cap/volume snapshot (coins/markets), coin-to-contract mapping (coins/list?include_platform=true), per-coin metadata and images

sources.name: Trust Wallet assets
sources.use: per-address info.json (status, decimals, symbol) and preferred logo.png, pinned commit

sources.name: Uniswap default token list
sources.use: independent address/decimals cross-check (Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain, Arbitrum One, Base)

sources.name: Jupiter verified token list
sources.use: independent cross-check, holder counts and liquidity (Solana)

sources.name: Blockscout / GeckoTerminal
sources.use: holder counts used only as a selection filter (not stored in the registry)

sources.name: Public RPC
sources.url: https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com, https://bsc-rpc.publicnode.com, https://arbitrum-one-rpc.publicnode.com, https://base-rpc.publicnode.com, https://api.trongrid.io, https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com
sources.use: on-chain decimals, symbol, total supply, Solana mint owner program and Metaplex/Token-2022 metadata

method.ranking: rank = order by snapshot valueUsd = min(CoinGecko market cap, on-chain total supply x CoinGecko price); for bridged tokens without a CoinGecko market cap the on-chain value is used; Wrapped SOL uses its CoinGecko market cap because the native mint reports zero supply.

eligibility.ethereum: value >= $20M, 24h volume >= $250k (or value >= $500M with volume >= $50k), >= 5,000 holders (Blockscout), listed by Trust Wallet or an independent list
eligibility.smartchain: value >= $10M, 24h volume >= $250k (or value >= $300M with volume >= $50k), >= 5,000 holders where known (GeckoTerminal), Trust Wallet record or (two independent lists and >= 20,000 holders); top 50 by value
eligibility.arbitrum: value >= $2M, 24h volume >= $100k (or value >= $100M with volume >= $50k), >= 1,000 holders (Blockscout), independent list; canonical-bridge weETH/rsETH admitted despite low per-chain CoinGecko volume
eligibility.base: value >= $5M, 24h volume >= $250k (or value >= $100M with volume >= $50k), >= 10,000 holders (Blockscout), independent list; the 50 highest-value eligible tokens minus MEY (Trust Wallet/on-chain metadata conflict), plus USDbC (explicitly named bridged variant with ~474k holders)
eligibility.tron: real, actively used TRC-20 tokens only: TronScan-verified with material holder counts and recent transfers; deprecated contracts (USDC, USDDOLD, SUNOLD, BUSD) and sanctioned A7A5 excluded
eligibility.solana: Jupiter verified, >= 10,000 holders, 24h volume >= $250k or DEX liquidity >= $1M, value >= $8M; small derivative memes and leveraged/receipt tokens removed on review

excludedCategories: tokenized funds and permissioned securities (BUIDL, USYC, USDY, Spiko, JAAA, etc.)
lending/vault/staking receipt tokens (aTokens, Morpho/Maple vaults, sENA, stkAAVE, vTokens)
superseded or deprecated contracts (MKR, legacy FRAX, BUSD, Sollet assets, old TRON contracts)
